recognize_zh: 中央一顆雙核的嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞（binucleate erythroblast），細胞質深藍、兩個核大小相近，是紅血球生成異常（dyserythropoiesis）的例子；周圍有顆粒粗大的桿狀與分葉嗜中性球。
features: Binucleate basophilic erythroblast with two similar-sized nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Nuclei with coarse granular chromatin and perinuclear clearing
Adjacent band and segmented neutrophils with coarse granulation
Myelocytes and scattered erythroid precursors in the background
Background of platelets and red cells without increased blasts
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a binucleate basophilic erythroblast with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and two symmetric nuclei, indicating dyserythropoiesis. Nearby granulocytes, including bands and segmented neutrophils, show coarse granulation, and myelocytes are present. Blasts are not increased in this field, and prominent vacuolization is not evident in the erythroblast shown. In a patient with a UBA1 p.Met41Leu variant, findings are consistent with the dyserythropoiesis described in VEXAS syndrome.

ddx.vs: MDS shows identical multinucleated erythroblasts, so UBA1 sequencing, precursor vacuoles and inflammatory features are needed to identify VEXAS.
Megaloblastic erythroblasts show open, sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, rather than the coarse chromatin seen here.
CDA II shows many binucleate late erythroblasts from childhood with SEC23B mutation and normal granulopoiesis.
